reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: New Jersey
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Secondary methods of service may be used if the primary method is unsuccessful.
              Is posting a permitted secondary method of service for an eviction action?
*/

/* -----------------------------
   Scenario facts (question statement)
   ----------------------------- */

% State and year context
scenario_state(new_jersey).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% We model a single eviction action in the scenario.
scenario_action(eviction_action_1).

% The action is an eviction (summary dispossess / possession-type) matter.
scenario_action_type(eviction_action_1, eviction).

% "Secondary methods ... may be used if the primary method is unsuccessful."
% Encode that the primary method (usual/personal service) is unsuccessful/unavailable.
scenario_primary_service_unsuccessful(eviction_action_1).

% Provide factual conditions that trigger posting under NJ Rev Stat  2A:18-54:
% "when admission to the premises is denied OR the tenant/occupant and family above 14 are absent
%  OR there is no person actually occupying them" then posting is allowed.
scenario_admission_denied(eviction_action_1).

% Helper predicate: succeeds when the encoded scenario statement is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(new_jersey),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_action(Action),
    scenario_action_type(Action, eviction),
    scenario_primary_service_unsuccessful(Action).

/* -----------------------------
   Statute translations (deterministic legal predicates)
   ----------------------------- */

% --- NJ Rev Stat  2A:18-54 (2021)
% "Where ... notices ... cannot be served ... or a summons and complaint cannot be served ...
%  such notices or summons and complaint may be served ... upon any person actually occupying ...
%  or by leaving ... with a family member above 14 ...
%  or when admission is denied or the tenant/occupant and family above 14 are absent
%  or there is no person actually occupying, ... may post or affix ... upon the door or other
%  conspicuous part ... Such posting shall be deemed to be lawful service."
%
% We encode that posting is a lawful substituted (secondary) service method when primary service is unavailable
% AND one of the statutory posting triggers is present.
statute_2a18_54_allows_posting(Action) :-
    primary_service_unavailable(Action),
    (   admission_denied(Action)
    ;   tenant_and_family_over_14_absent(Action)
    ;   no_person_actually_occupying(Action)
    ),
    !.

% Additional substituted methods mentioned in  2A:18-54 (not needed for the final answer but included).
statute_2a18_54_allows_personal_on_occupant(Action) :-
    primary_service_unavailable(Action),
    person_actually_occupying_present(Action),
    !.

statute_2a18_54_allows_leave_with_family_over_14(Action) :-
    primary_service_unavailable(Action),
    family_member_over_14_present(Action),
    !.

% --- NJ Rev Stat  2A:42-7 (2021)
% "If the summons ... cannot be served in the usual manner, ... may affix the same upon the demised premises
%  in a conspicuous place ... deemed legal service."
statute_2a42_7_allows_affixing_summons(Action) :-
    action_for_possession_nonpayment_one_year_arrears(Action),
    summons_cannot_be_served_usual_manner(Action),
    !.

% --- NJ Rev Stat  2A:42-89 (2021)
% "Notice ... shall be given ... by affixing a copy of the petition upon a conspicuous part of the subject dwelling."
statute_2a42_89_requires_affixing_petition_notice(Action) :-
    proceeding_under_2a42_89_act(Action),
    nonpetitioning_tenant_occupying_dwelling(Action),
    !.

/* -----------------------------
   Bridging predicates: scenario -> legal conditions
   (All rules needed for reasoning appear here.)
   ----------------------------- */

% Primary service unavailable in scenario if primary service unsuccessful.
primary_service_unavailable(Action) :-
    scenario_primary_service_unsuccessful(Action),
    !.
primary_service_unavailable(_Action) :-
    fail.

% Posting triggers from scenario.
admission_denied(Action) :-
    scenario_admission_denied(Action),
    !.
admission_denied(_Action) :-
    fail.

tenant_and_family_over_14_absent(_Action) :-
    fail.

no_person_actually_occupying(_Action) :-
    fail.

% Presence predicates (not used in this scenario, but defined for completeness and to avoid undefined calls).
person_actually_occupying_present(_Action) :-
    fail.

family_member_over_14_present(_Action) :-
    fail.

%  2A:42-7 bridging predicates (not used in this scenario).
action_for_possession_nonpayment_one_year_arrears(_Action) :-
    fail.

summons_cannot_be_served_usual_manner(_Action) :-
    fail.

%  2A:42-89 bridging predicates (not used in this scenario).
proceeding_under_2a42_89_act(_Action) :-
    fail.

nonpetitioning_tenant_occupying_dwelling(_Action) :-
    fail.

/* -----------------------------
   Derived legal conclusion:
   "posting is a permitted secondary method of service for an eviction action"
   ----------------------------- */

% A general predicate describing whether "posting" is permitted as a secondary method of service
% for the given action, derived from the encoded statutes.
permitted_secondary_service_method(posting, Action) :-
    scenario_action_type(Action, eviction),
    statute_2a18_54_allows_posting(Action),
    !.
permitted_secondary_service_method(posting, Action) :-
    % Additional NJ statutes that also treat posting/affixing as legal service in possession contexts.
    (   statute_2a42_7_allows_affixing_summons(Action)
    ;   statute_2a42_89_requires_affixing_petition_notice(Action)
    ),
    !.
permitted_secondary_service_method(_Method, _Action) :-
    fail.

/* -----------------------------
   Answer predicate (deterministic)
   ----------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_action(Action),
    permitted_secondary_service_method(posting, Action),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* -----------------------------
   Main entrypoint
   ----------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Secondary methods of service are defined as those methods that may be used if the primary method is unsuccessful. Is posting a permitted secondary method of service for an eviction action?
